title: Parking Occupancy Dashboard
overview: A small operational view reports capacity, occupied spaces, available spaces, and whether entry is currently allowed.
main_flow: The system loads capacity and occupied count.
The system returns total, occupied, available, and OPEN or FULL status.

alternative_flows.condition: The counter is outside its valid range.
alternative_flows.result: Return a data-integrity warning and fail the entry decision closed.

business_rules: Available equals max(capacity minus occupied, zero).
Only successful ticket creation and first ticket closure affect the counter.
